name: Mall Waste Sorting Station
summary: A three-stream mall sorting station with blue recycling, jade food and slate general-waste modules, genuine open apertures and editable labels.
description: An original modular waste sorting station with separate hollow compartments, removable color-coded lids, geometric bottle / leaf / bag pictograms, porcelain service doors and a shared midnight-blue frame.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original deterministic Blender Python geometry and Principled BSDF materials. Blender bundled Bfont is retained as editable source text and exported as mesh geometry. No external models or textures.

replacement.note: Edit the Blender source text or objects within the named collections, save, then use generate.py -- --export-source. Rebuilding without that option replaces manual edits. No live sorting, label editing or lid animation is offered by the gallery.

accuracy_notes: Original decorative concept, not a certified waste system, municipal sorting standard, accessibility specification or fabrication/engineering design. Streams, colors and acceptable items must be adapted to local rules.

attribution.credit: Original geometry authored for Blender-3D-Gallery. Labels use bundled Blender Bfont; no external artwork.

rights: Original asset; reuse in the owner's projects is authorized. Public redistribution terms have not been specified.
